cves.title: PHP-CGI argument injection on Windows lets an attacker run code
cves.fix: Upgrade PHP to 8.1.29, 8.2.20 or 8.3.8, or stop running PHP in CGI mode on Windows.

cves.title: OpenSSH regreSSHion: a race condition in sshd lets an attacker run code remotely
nginx ngx_http_mp4_module: a crafted file can crash a worker process
cves.fix: Upgrade nginx to 1.26.2 or 1.27.1, or switch the mp4 module off.

items.name: Path traversal or local file inclusion
Session not ended on logout or password change
Changing or deleting other users’ data (IDOR)
Missing check on an administrative function
Passwords stored in plain text or with a weak hash
Sensitive data sent over plain HTTP
Admin panel or debug console exposed
Outdated component with a known CVE
Database or admin service open to the internet
Secrets hard-coded in the app package
Sensitive data stored insecurely on the device
No limit on a costly action (SMS, email)
Model tricked into using tools it should not
Denial of service with a single request
